exam.methodMarkNote: In the real exam you would still get the method mark here, even though the final answer is wrong. That is a mark most students throw away by writing nothing down.
exam.realQuestions: These are real NSC questions, marked the way the examiner marks them.
exam.masteredDetail: You said you had this, and you did. Nothing more to do here.
exam.slippedDetail: You knew this one - you just did not get all of it down. Losing part marks on a question you can do is the cheapest kind of mark to win back.
exam.blindSpotDetail: You were sure about this one and it did not come out. That is the kind of mark that goes missing in the real exam, because there is no reason to go back and check it. Worth drilling.
exam.underconfident: You knew more than you thought
exam.underconfidentDetail: You said this was new to you and then got it. Back yourself next time - claiming it is worth more.
exam.honestGapDetail: You said you were not sure, and you were right. This is what practice is for.
exam.tagline: Real NSC questions, marked like the examiner
